After Ayodhya and Kashi, is Mathura the BJP's next big political move?
The Krishna Janmabhoomi-Shahi Idgah dispute in Mathura is back in focus as the BJP prepares to make the demand for a grand Krishna Janmabhoomi temple a key issue ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections.
What is the history of the Krishna Janmabhoomi temple dispute? Why is the Shahi Idgah mosque at the centre of the legal battle? What has happened in court so far, and what is the BJP's political strategy for Mathura?
